cat > /opt/inventory-lb/lb.py <<'PYEOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python2
import itertools
import urllib2
import threading
from BaseHTTPServer import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer

BACKENDS = ["http://10.100.4.11:8080", "http://10.100.4.12:8080"]

_lock = threading.Lock()
_cycle = itertools.cycle(BACKENDS)

def next_backend():
    with _lock:
        return next(_cycle)

class LBHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        self._proxy()

    def do_POST(self):
        self._proxy()

    def _proxy(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0) or 0)
        body = self.rfile.read(length) if length else None

        last_err = None
        for _ in range(len(BACKENDS)):
            backend = next_backend()
            url = backend + self.path
            try:
                req = urllib2.Request(url, data=body)
                req.get_method = lambda: self.command
                resp = urllib2.urlopen(req, timeout=3)
                self.send_response(resp.getcode())
                self.send_header("Content-Type", resp.headers.get("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream"))
                self.send_header("X-Upstream", backend)
                data = resp.read()
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(data)
                return
            except Exception as e:
                last_err = e
                continue
        self.send_response(502)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write("Bad Gateway: %s" % last_err)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    server = HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 80), LBHandler)
    server.serve_forever()
PYEOF
